name: mcp-transcribe
description: Local MCP server that transcribes existing audio files with Whisper. Uses mlx-whisper on Apple Silicon (Metal-accelerated) and falls back to faster-whisper on CPU. No microphone or speaker access, by design.

tools.name: transcribe_file
tools.description: Transcribe an audio file on disk and return the transcript plus timed segments

tools.name: backend_info
tools.description: Report the active STT backend and whether ffmpeg is present
